written_findings: (W1) Weyl-covariant family: cells g in Z10^2, vectors D(g)psi, rows/columns/classes translation-invariant partitions. Invariant partitions are cosets of subgroups A1,A2,A3 of order 10 with pairwise trivial intersection; then each A_k=l_k x lambda_k (l_k a Z2^2 line, lambda_k a Z5^2 line) under CRT, the three l_k are all three Z2 lines, and the three lambda_k are distinct.
(W2) Row/column/class ONB conditions hold iff psi is unbiased to the three eigenbases of A1,A2,A3 (each is a MASA of the Weyl group, with simple spectrum).

(W3) Exactly TWO Clifford classes. SL(2,2) is simply transitive on ordered Z2-line triples. PSL(2,5) is free on ordered triples of P^1(F5), with two orbits. Antiunitary conjugation acts on lines through PSL because -1 is a square mod 5. Representatives: class B = (Z,X,XZ) [the Grassl-McNulty-Mista-Paterek triple] and class A = (Z,X,XZ^3). In C^5 coordinates (Z10=Z2 x Z5^3, X10=X2 x X5), class B has third basis X5Z5^3 with chirp coefficient 4 (a square) and class A has X5Z5^4 with chirp coefficient 2 (a nonsquare).

(W4) Any solution psi is automatically MAXIMAL (100 pairwise nonparallel rays). If D(g)psi is proportional to psi with g!=0, a nonzero Z2 part makes 5g a nonzero element of some A_k, which is a contradiction. Otherwise psi is an eigenvector of I tensor D5, hence a product state. That contradicts the maximally mixed qubit marginal forced by unbiasedness to the three product bases.

(W5) Galois conjugacy: sigma_7 in Gal(Q(zeta20)/Q) maps Z,X,XZ^3 eigenbases to Z,X,XZ eigenbases (i -> -i only flips the y-basis labels). The complexified real-variable varieties V_A and V_B are therefore Galois conjugate. Consequences: (a) if the GMMP certificate is complex emptiness (unit ideal), class A is empty too; (b) under real emptiness of class B alone, no class-A solution has all coordinates in an abelian number field containing zeta20, because sigma_7 commutes with complex conjugation there.

(W6) Symmetric slices: the stabilizer of each class is Dic3 (order 12, includes C^5 parity). C^10 = triv+sgn+2sigma+sigma+phi+chi1+chi3. chi1/chi3 eigenvectors have odd C^5 factors, so b(0)=0 and they are not flat. triv/sgn eigenvectors force P=Sigma (the sigma part of the even space), which needs |<e0,w_sgn>|^2=3/5. The icosahedral angle gives (1+2/sqrt5)/3 for class B (face) and (1-2/sqrt5)/3 for class A (nonface), so both fail. The Z3-fixed slice has 9 real conditions on 6 unknowns.
exact_remaining_gap: Existence of psi in C^10 unbiased to the Z, X and XZ^3 eigenbases (class A). Any such psi gives a maximal 1-RQLS(10) by W2/W4. Not decided: no numerical or computer search is admitted under HOLD.
